label: PF Backlog 199
title: Backend: media agents (media-analyst / media-generator / media-editor / asset-librarian)
body:
## Problem / why
No agent understands, generates, edits, or organises media.

## Goal
Add pluggable media agents, enabled only when the capability pack is active:
- media-analyst: VLM understanding of image/audio/video.
- media-generator: drive generator models.
- media-editor: cut/merge/render (ffmpeg/MoviePy/Blender).
- asset-librarian: index/manage the asset store.

## Acceptance criteria
- Agents are added to the roster + stages and gated by the capability pack.
- Each agent declares knowledge/skills (agent-knowledge audit stays green).

## Verification / test plan
- Enable the media pack -> agents appear and run in the media stages; disabled otherwise.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability; consumed via API, no UI change.
